message.content:
Based on a meticulous visual review of the provided UI, here are the measurable defects:

1.  **Truncated Data Columns (Zones Table):** In the "Zones & metrics" table, the "Time" and "%" columns are severely truncated. The numerical values for each zone (Z1 through Z5) are clipped, showing only partial digits or being completely cut off by the right edge of the container.
2.  **Clipped Modal Content:** The "Zones & metrics settings" modal/popup is rendering partially outside its intended bounds. The text at the bottom of the modal ("Floors of zones...") and the lower input fields ("Power zones") are cut off by the bottom edge of the viewport or parent container.
3.  **Clipped Descriptive Text:** The introductory sentence in the "Zones & metrics" section ("Time in each zone over the route as it would export...") is truncated at the right margin before it can finish the word "out".
